name: Mydentify

sources.title: List your product — 4-step flow (paste URL → review draft → select solutions → publish); free listing needs a public Mydentify badge/link before they publish the followed link; paid skips the badge wait

conditions: Free listings require a public Mydentify link or badge on your site BEFORE the followed link is published
Sign-in is required at the publish step (not needed to start the draft)
Paid profile option skips the badge wait — editorial accuracy still applies
requirements: Product is matched to user pain points ('solutions'), not just a category label — pick the solution(s) the product solves
Draft is auto-generated from facts on your site — you review name, URL, category, pricing, description before publish
Followed (dofollow) link is explicit for published listings; they disclaim no guaranteed DR/ranking gains
Positioned as a lasting reviewed profile, not a 24-hour launch spike
preparation: Product homepage URL — the draft is generated from what's on your site, so accurate public copy/pricing matters
Ability to add a Mydentify badge/link to your site for the free route
Account for sign-in at publish time
workflow: Open https://mydentify.com/submit and paste the product URL (no login needed yet)
Review the auto-generated draft; fix mismatches
Select the solution(s) the product addresses
Choose publish path: free (add badge/link first) or paid (skip the badge wait)
Sign in to finalize; listing publishes as a public product page
watchFor: Free path is a reciprocal-badge deal — verify their badge requirements at /listing-badge
Draft accuracy depends on your site's public copy — clean up homepage claims first
Honest copy: they explicitly do NOT promise traffic, votes, DR gains, or rankings
Rankings on their leaderboards are activity-based and not guaranteed
countsAsLive: The product has a stable public page on mydentify.com (visible in /products and solution/category views) with a followed outbound link
unknowns: Paid listing price (pricing page not fetched)
